title: Indonesia Power Profile
scope: Lowy Institute Asia Power Index, not a Strategic Latitude geopolitical risk or investment advice rating.

source.title: Asia Power Index — Indonesia country profile

overview.classification: Middle power in Asia (Lowy Institute classification)
analysis_points: Indonesia remains a middle power and ranks ninth among 27 indexed economies.
Future resources and diplomatic influence are its highest-ranked dimensions (fifth).
Resilience improved, while defence networks declined most sharply in the latest annual comparison.
A positive power gap indicates that Indonesia exercises more influence than its resource base alone would suggest; its exact magnitude is not given here.

metrics.name: Economic capability
metrics.description: Economic size and geopolitical economic capacity
metrics.interpretation: Relatively modest compared with Indonesia's regional demographic and resource weight.

metrics.name: Military capability
metrics.interpretation: Indonesia's lowest-ranking of the eight measures in 2025.

metrics.name: Resilience
metrics.description: Ability to withstand and deter threats to national stability
metrics.interpretation: Biggest annual score gain, with resource security among contributing factors.

metrics.name: Future resources
metrics.description: Projected future economic, military and demographic resources
metrics.interpretation: Top-five ranking; its rank improved despite an unchanged measure score.

metrics.name: Economic relationships
metrics.interpretation: The rank fell even as the underlying score rose; these are different measures.

metrics.name: Defence networks
metrics.description: Defence partnerships as multipliers of military capability
metrics.interpretation: Largest annual score decline; rank also fell.

metrics.name: Diplomatic influence
metrics.description: Reach and standing of foreign relations
metrics.interpretation: Indonesia's highest-scoring measure and joint-best rank.

metrics.name: Cultural influence
metrics.description: Regional and international cultural attraction and engagement

annual_change.notes: Score change and rank movement are distinct. Score deltas expressed in points; rank movements expressed in places.

influence.category: Bilateral merchandise and services trade, current USD (Lowy bilateral trade influence presentation)

into_indonesia.title: Which partners account for Indonesia's trade?
into_indonesia.subtitle: Share of Indonesia's trade by partner, as presented in the Lowy country profile.
into_indonesia.denominator: Percent of Indonesia's reported global bilateral trade (2024).

indonesia_influence.title: Which economies depend most on trade with Indonesia?
indonesia_influence.subtitle: Indonesia's share of each partner's trade, as presented in the Lowy country profile.
indonesia_influence.denominator: Share of each recipient/partner economy's own trade accounted for by Indonesia (2024), NOT percentages of Indonesia's exports.

constraints: Do not confuse Asia Power Index scores with country investment-risk ratings.
The eight measure scores do not sum to overall comprehensive power because the index uses Lowy's weighting/methodology.
Rank movements and score-point changes are not interchangeable.
Trade partner percentages and recipient-economy exposure percentages have different denominators.
Snapshot is the 2025 published index; not a live real-time power score.
Original Lowy analysis and graphics are not reproduced; this page presents an independently designed source-attributed summary.
